# AwsEcsTarget

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/awsecstarget.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

The minimum AWS infrastructure a container deploys into on ECS Fargate - cluster, task definition, service, execution role and, by default, a small dedicated public network. Disposable: delete the XR to remove all of it.

## How it is requested

A stand-alone XR request in the tenants repo (`tenants/<app>/xr-requests/`), or composed by a function app with `spec.target.enabled`. See docs/user/cloud-targets.md.

## Conditions

Besides Crossplane's Ready and Synced. Reasons are a closed set:

- `TargetReady`: `AwsEcsTargetReady` (True), `AwsEcsTargetProvisioning` (False), `AwsEcsTargetServicePending` (False).

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify awsecstarget <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `xr-ready` (condition): The AwsEcsTarget XR's TargetReady condition has reason AwsEcsTargetReady.
- `service-stable` (cloudCli): aws ecs describe-services --cluster {cluster} --services {service} reports runningCount == desiredCount.
- `port-answers` (manual): An HTTP GET of http://<task public IP>:{containerPort}/ (the IP from aws ecs describe-tasks and describe-network-interfaces) returns a response.

## Editing this composition

- Edit `compositions/awsecstarget/templates/`, never the inline blocks in `composition.yaml`: `python3 tools/build-compositions awsecstarget` splices them.
- `python3 tools/test_compositions.py --update awsecstarget` regenerates `example/expected/`; review that diff like code, it is the behaviour change.
- `python3 tools/test_sidecars.py` fails if a template change breaks a name this sidecar promises.
- terraform-provider-aws revokes AWS's default egress rule when it creates a security group, so the composition adds an explicit egress SecurityGroupRule.

Contract: `tools/airframe-capabilities verify awsecstarget`; schema: `xrds/awsecstarget.yaml`.
